articles.title: Open USD rattled Circle's stock, but its key backers still support USDC
articles.snippet: Executives at Coinbase, Visa and Mastercard said they plan to support multiple stablecoins, suggesting Open USD is another payments rail rather than a direct replacement for USDC.

articles.title: Samsung is poised to become a dominant stablecoin distributor, analysts say
articles.snippet: Samsung seeks to turn 800 million Galaxy phones into wallets for digital assets and blockchain payments, backed by a deeper play in crypto infrastructure.

articles.title: BlackRock debuts tokenized access to $311 billion of money market funds in Europe
articles.snippet: Earlier this week, BlackRock expanded its U.S. tokenized cash platform which involved offering onchain shares of an existing fund, plus a new daily reinvestment stablecoin fund.

articles.title: Mastercard completes $1.8B BVNK acquisition in stablecoin push
articles.snippet: Mastercard said the tie-up would help banks, fintechs and enterprises expand stablecoin payments, payouts, settlement and treasury services.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market funds for stablecoin reserves
articles.snippet: The asset manager introduced two blockchain-based money market funds designed to qualify as stablecoin reserve assets under the US GENIUS Act.
